decisions.reason: The air quality module is a featured, distinctive part of the modular sensor system and serves a growing indoor-air market, so it likely meets aspirations and justifies the low cost of keeping it listed.
As the current-generation replacement for an established measurement module, it is a core building block of the system, and no shortfall would trigger problemistic search.
The CAN bus interface fills a niche in industrial connectivity and costs little to carry, though component shortages pose a modest risk.
The CO2 sensor module was presented on a page of its own, and demand for room-air monitoring has risen, so its results likely exceed aspirations.
